_comment_execution_environments: Each SiLA2 server does `sys.path.insert(0, <its own root>)` at runtime (see main.py in each) so its own `from src.xxx import yyy` / `from generated.xxx import yyy` resolve against ITS OWN src/generated, not v1/src. Every server ships a package literally named `src`, so a single flat extraPaths list (the old config) made resolution ambiguous/wrong for whichever server wasn't first. executionEnvironments scope extraPaths per subtree instead, matched by root, most-specific first. This file lives at the repo root (c:\LabOS) rather than under v1/ because that's the actual VSCode workspace root Pylance uses to search for a config -- a v1/pyrightconfig.json is invisible to the live IDE.
